package: @astryxdesign/core

# ListItem

List item with label, description, start/end content slots, and interactive patterns.

**Import:** `import {ListItem} from '@astryxdesign/core/List';`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Primary content. A plain string gets single-line truncation automatically; a ReactNode renders as given, so child components control their own text behavior. **(required)** |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Secondary content below the label. A plain string gets single-line truncation automatically; a ReactNode lets child components control their own wrapping and line-clamp behavior. |
| `startContent` | `ReactNode` | - | Content rendered before the label area (e.g. icon, avatar). |
| `endContent` | `ReactNode` | - | Content rendered after the label area (e.g. badge, chevron). |
| `onClick` | `(e: MouseEvent) => void` | - | Click handler; enables the invisible button pattern. |
| `interactiveRef` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` | - | Ref to a nested control (e.g. a checkbox in startContent) that owns the item's keyboard access and action. The row becomes an enlarged click/tap target that delegates surface clicks to it (useClickableContainer) and renders no invisible button/anchor, so the row adds no second tab stop (WCAG 4.1.2). Mutually exclusive with onClick/href; those are ignored when set. |
| `href` | `string` | - | Link URL; enables the invisible anchor pattern. The destination follows the shared navigation rule described on the Link `href` prop. |
| `target` | `string` | - | Link target attribute, only applicable when href is provided. target="_blank" automatically adds noopener noreferrer. |
| `rel` | `string` | - | Link relationship tokens. noopener noreferrer are merged automatically for target="_blank". |
| `align` | `'center' \| 'start' \| 'first-line'` | `'center'` | Vertical alignment of the start and end content against the label, passed through to Item unchanged. `first-line` keeps a small mark (a status dot, an icon) level with the first line of a wrapped label. See Item.align. |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disabled state; sets aria-disabled on the item. |
| `isSelected` | `boolean` | `false` | Selected state; marks the item as the current one with aria-current="true" (a list item cannot carry aria-selected). |
| `itemKey` | `string \| number` | - | The row's item key, a string or a number from the data (the shape Table's idKey returns). It is the row's identity for the list's animated layout (List animatedLayout): with a handle, the list matches rows by it to animate inserts, removals and moves, and a row without one changes at once. In a reorderable List (List reorderable), it is the key the reorderable object's onReorder reports and isReorderable is asked about, and a row without one has no reorder handle and keeps its place. Separate from React's key. |
| `swipeActions` | `{leading?: ItemSwipeAction[]; trailing?: ItemSwipeAction[]}` | - | Swipe actions for touch, passed through to Item unchanged: the verbs a sideways drag uncovers on each side, each `{id?, label, icon?, onActivate, isDisabled?, variant?: 'neutral' \| 'accent' \| 'destructive', hasRemoval?}`. See Item.swipeActions; List clips its rows in the inline axis for them. |
| `swipeBehavior` | `'reveal' \| 'commit'` | `'reveal'` | What a swipe does, passed through to Item unchanged. See Item.swipeBehavior. |
